mapper.select:
SELECT PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, PORTFOLIO_NAME portfolioName FROM PTL_PORTFOLIO
AND PORTFOLIO_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{filter},'%'))

SELECT USER_ID portfolioId FROM PTL_PORTFOLIO_AUTHORITY
PORTFOLIO_ID = #{portfolioId}
SELECT ACCT_NAME acctName, BANK_DEP bankDep, LARGE_PAYNO largePayno FROM STL_CAPACCT_INFO WHERE ACCT_NO = #{acctNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND CCY = #{ccy,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT SEC.SEC_ACCT_NAME secAcctName, SEC.REGIST_ORG registOrg, SEC.REC_ACCT_ID recAcctId, SEC.TRD_ACCT_ID trdAcctId, SEC.SEC_ACCT_SOURCE secAcctSource, CAP.ACCT_NAME acctName FROM STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO SEC INNER JOIN STL_CAPACCT_INFO CAP ON SEC.TRD_ACCT_ID = CAP.ACCT_NO WHERE SEC.SEC_ACCT_ID = #{secAcctNo}
SELECT ACCT_NO FROM PTL_SEC_ACCT WHERE PORTFOLIO_ID = #{portfolioId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT PTL.PORTFOLIO_ID PORTFOLIO_ID, PTL.ACCT_NO acctNo, PTL.CCY ccy, PTL.ACCT_TYPE acctType, STL.ACCT_NAME acctName, STL.BANK_DEP bankDep, STL.LARGE_PAYNO largePayNo FROM PTL_CAPACCT_INFO PTL INNER JOIN STL_CAPACCT_INFO STL ON PTL.ACCT_NO = STL.ACCT_NO WHERE PORTFOLIO_ID = #{portfolioId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT T1.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, T1.PORTFOLIO_TYPE portfolioType, T1.PORTFOLIO_NAME portfolioName, T1.VDATE vdate, T1.MDATE mdate, T2.IS_GUARANTEE isGuarantee, T2.OPEN_TYPE openType, T2.RAISE_TYPE raiseType, T2.INVEST_NATURE investNature, T1.PROFIT_TYPE profitType FROM PTL_PORTFOLIO T1 LEFT JOIN PA_PTL_PORTFOLIO T2 ON T1.PORTFOLIO_ID = T2.PORTFOLIO_ID WHERE T1.PORTFOLIO_ID = #{portfolioId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
SELECT USER_ID FROM PTL_PORTFOLIO_AUTHORITY WHERE PORTFOLIO_ID = #{portfolioId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT count(*) FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL T1 LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD T2 ON T1.TRADE_ID = T2.TRADE_ID WHERE T1.TRADE_STATUS = #{tradeStatus} AND T1.IS_CANCEL = #{yesno_n} AND T2.PORTFOLIO_ID = #{portfolioId}
SELECT INSTITUTION_CODE code, INSTITUTION_NAME name, UPPER_INSTITUTION_CODE upperCode FROM SYS_INSTITUTION
SELECT DEPT_CODE code, DEPT_NAME name, CASE WHEN UPPER_DEPT_CODE IS NULL THEN INSTITUTION_CODE ELSE UPPER_DEPT_CODE END AS upperCode FROM SYS_DEPARTMENT
SELECT USER_NAME code, REAL_NAME name, DEPT_CODE upperCode FROM SYS_USER
mapper.delete: delete from FIN_CASH_INFO where FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} and FINPROD_TYPE = #{finprodType}
